description: This file implements JavaScript bindings and interaction logic for an Amazon-related player module within the WPEFramework, including dynamic library loading, message handling, and registration of JavaScript callbacks.

classes.name: AmazonPlayer
classes.description: Singleton class managing the Amazon player library, message callbacks, and JavaScript context integration.

classes.name: registerMessageListener
classes.description: Handles registration of JavaScript callback functions for message listening.

classes.name: sendMessage
classes.description: Handles sending messages from JavaScript to the Amazon player library.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Retrieves configuration string from WPEWebKitBrowser via synchronous message.

methods.name: ListenerCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a message is received; calls the registered JavaScript listener.

methods.name: RegisterMessageListener
methods.description: Registers a JavaScript callback as message listener.

methods.name: HandleMessage
methods.description: Handles JavaScript invocation to register message listener or send message.
